answer: Stake deposit gates each agent's entry vote. Agents earning trust then mint reputation tokens toward a shared grove fund, sized like a walnut: small core of bonded capital, hard shell of slashing. An attacker launching a voyage of fake identities must fund each deposit separately, so cost grows linearly while honest reputation compounds quadratically. Bottleneck: every sybil duplicate demands fresh locked capital, making large-scale forgery unprofitable.
